data.name: Solomon Islands
data.summary: Solomon Islands taxes residents on worldwide income at up to 40% (above SBD 60,000, after a SBD 30,080 tax-free threshold). Dividends, domestic and foreign, are income: Solomon dividends bear 20% withholding credited against the 40% scale; foreign dividends get a credit for overseas tax. There is no specific capital gains tax, and capital gains of a private investor appear untaxed (low confidence). No inheritance, gift or wealth tax was found.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Residents taxed on worldwide income at up to 40%; no specific CGT.
regimes.eligibility: Resident if the individual resides in Solomon Islands; deemed resident if present more than six months in aggregate in the year or intending to reside more than six months (Income Tax Act Cap. 123 s. 2).

capital_gains.summary: No specific capital gains tax. Tax is charged on income (business gains, employment, dividends, interest, and 'income from any other source whatsoever', s. 3); capital gains of a private investor are not listed and on ordinary common-law principles are not income.

open_questions: No official statement that capital gains are untaxed was found; the 2012 consolidation is unofficial and later amendments were not read.
IRD publishes a 'formal tax policy work programme' and draft consultations (not read); a tax reform could change this.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Inference from Income Tax Act Cap. 123 s. 3 (charge on income); no CGT provision found. 0 for all classes, low confidence.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Gains from a business of dealing in shares or land are business income at up to 40%. The Act also mentions gains of a landowner from the sale of land in its deduction rules (not analysed).
capital_gains.foreign_assets: Residents are taxed on income from all sources, but capital gains are not income.

dividends.summary: Dividends are charged to tax (s. 3(1)(b)) and residents are taxed on income from all sources (s. 3(2)(a)). Resident companies withhold 20% from dividends paid to resident individuals (s. 36; IRD), which is final only if the individual's total income is under SBD 10,000; otherwise the dividend is taxed on the scale (top 40%) with credit for the 20%. Foreign dividends are taxed on the scale with relief for overseas tax at the lower of the two rates (s. 44).
dividends.exemptions_thresholds: IRD: tax-free threshold SBD 30,080 from January 2020; above it 11% to 15,000, 23% to 30,000, 35% to 60,000, 40% above 60,000 (bands applied to income above the threshold as published).

open_questions: The IRD rate table wording ('$1 to $15 000 11%' after the SBD 30,080 threshold) is ambiguous about whether bands start at 0 or at the threshold; the 40% top rate is not affected.
dividends.rate_basis: Top marginal rate 40% (IRD income tax page) applies to dividends of a high-income resident; the 20% dividend WHT is a credit, not a final tax, above SBD 10,000 total income (s. 36(5)). Foreign: 40% before s. 44 relief.
dividends.withholding_outbound: 30% on dividends paid to non-residents (IRD withholding page); 20% to residents.
dividends.treaty_network: No comprehensive treaties found (not verified). US dividends bear 30% US WHT, creditable.

wealth_tax.summary: No net wealth tax and no recurring levy on financial assets.

inheritance.summary: No inheritance, estate or gift tax appears among the tax laws the Inland Revenue Division administers (Income Tax, Goods Tax, Sales Tax, Stamp Duty, Tax Administration). Stamp duty (Cap. 126) may apply to instruments transferring land or shares.

inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax found; stamp duty may apply to transfer instruments.

residency.tax_residency_test: Income Tax Act Cap. 123 s. 2: an individual is resident if he resides in Solomon Islands except for temporary absences; deemed resident if present more than six months in aggregate in the year, or the Commissioner is satisfied he intends to reside more than six months, or he is present under an employment contract of at least six months.

corporate.summary: Resident companies 30%, non-resident companies 35% (IRD). Dividends paid out bear 20% (resident) or 30% (non-resident) withholding.

data.us_citizen_notes: US citizens remain subject to US federal income, estate and gift tax on worldwide income and assets wherever they live; the app adds the federal layer. Where local tax on portfolio income is nil there is nothing to credit against US tax. Solomon Islands tax on foreign dividends (up to 40%) generally exceeds the US rate, so the local tax is the binding layer.

succession.name: Solomon Islands
succession.summary: The Wills, Probate and Administration Act (Cap. 33) applies to ordinary property, not to customary land, which passes by custom. No fixed heirship share or family provision was found. Trust and foundation law and Hague status are not confirmed.
succession.family_claims: Not found; the Act does not govern customary land or matters regulated by current customary usage (s 2).
succession.foreign_law_note: No conflict-of-law rule sourced. Perpetual estates pass on intestacy by current custom as certified by the local court (s 105).
succession.trust_note: Received UK trustee law is reported to apply; no local trust statute was sourced, so 'limited' is recorded. No foundation law found.
open_questions: The HCCH table as retrieved shows no entry for this jurisdiction (the retrieved copy was marked last updated 2017 and its territorial-extension notes could not be read); re-check the live table.
Trust/foundation availability marked unclear: no statute was found, which does not show that none exists.
